title: Home Additions in Treasure Valley | Miller Remodeling
description: Plan home additions with Miller Remodeling in Idaho’s Treasure Valley. Discuss your goals, layout and selections before construction.
heading: Room for what comes next.
intro: An addition should feel like it belongs — to your home, your neighborhood, and the life you want to live.

sections.heading: More space, with purpose.
paragraphs: Start with what your home is missing. A gathering room, a quieter workspace, or room for a growing family. We plan the connection between old and new as carefully as the addition itself.

sections.heading: Know the plan before you build.
paragraphs: A paid design phase helps you explore the layout, scale, and finishes. We work through the decisions together before the first wall goes up.

draftReason: Test copy for Erik review. This page is not approved for customer use or production.

faqs.question: How do I start a room for what comes next project?
faqs.answer: Start by sharing your goals, location and photos through the project inquiry. Erik reviews the brief so the first conversation can focus on what needs to change.

faqs.question: Are design and selections part of the planning phase?
faqs.answer: Yes. The paid design phase covers floorplans, selections and a 3D walkthrough before construction. Discuss the deliverables for your particular scope during consultation.
